QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q1 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Tense call. The Jan 14-16 Chicago storm delayed a large batch of Jaffle Equipment freight (a representative affected shipment is linked on this note) and the client raised the jackknife incident (INC-2025-00417) directly. On-time for January will breach the 97.0% target. Client asked, pointedly, whether Jaffle Logistics can handle their peak volumes. Committed to an SLA credit per contract CON-0042-01 and a written recovery plan. Sentiment concerned; first real crack in the relationship this year.

QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q1 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Q1 review with Jaffle Equipment. January storm credit applied and closed out. On-time recovering but still below the 97% target. Client cautious but constructive. Watching. Contract CON-0042-01.

QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q2 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Q2 review. On-time slipped again despite no major weather. Jaffle Equipment flagged three late LTL loads this quarter and rising ticket volume, cause not yet identified. Opening a root-cause review ahead of Q3. Contract CON-0042-01.

QBR — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), Q3 2025. Account owner: Marcus Trent.~~NL~~Q3 review. On-time is materially under target. The January Chicago storm (INC-2025-00417) explains part of it, but a second, weather-independent pattern has emerged: repeated handling damage at the Columbus hub (INC-2025-00136, INC-2025-00241, INC-2025-00095). Opening a root-cause review ahead of Q4. Contract CON-0042-01.

Q4 PERFORMANCE ROOT-CAUSE REVIEW — Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), contract CON-0042-01.~~NL~~Two contributing factors identified for 2025's on-time decline, documented separately: (1) the January 14-16 Chicago winter storm (INC-2025-00417, see IR-9001), a one-time weather event; (2) a recurring handling-damage pattern at the Columbus hub across three incidents in 2025 (INC-2025-00136, INC-2025-00241, INC-2025-00095, see IR-9003), pointing to a bay 3 forklift-staging issue rather than isolated events.~~NL~~Actions: (1) Columbus hub supervisor completing an SOP audit per IR-9003's remediation; (2) on-time tracked separately by cause (weather vs. handling) starting Q4 so recovery from each is visible independently. Owner: Marcus Trent. Review at Q1 2026 QBR.
